name: stat
title: Stat
description: One number that matters, with its label, an optional change (arrow, words for screen readers, colour by intent) and a description.
usage: Use Stat for a few key numbers: a query's time and row count, a table's size, connections in use. Compose Stat > StatLabel, StatValue, StatDelta (trend, intent), StatDescription. Format the value in the app (units, grouping). Set intent when up is bad (query time). Put stats in a row or in Cards; for many numbers use Table, for a series use a chart.

props.name: size
props.description: The value in text.heading-2 (md) or text.heading-4 (sm).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: delta
slots.description: Arrow, hidden trend words and the change; data-slot="stat-delta", data-trend, data-intent.

parts.name: StatDelta
parts.description: The change: trend (up, down, flat), intent (positive, negative, neutral), trendLabel.

states.name: neutral
states.description: A change that is neither: color.fg.muted.

accessibility: Plain text in reading order: label, value, change, description.
StatDelta's arrow is aria-hidden and the trend is said in words ("Up 12 %"), so the change never depends on the arrow or the colour.
Values use tabular figures so they line up; long labels truncate (put the full label in title if it matters).
